review_notes: Independently read the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json and link-dispositions.json, rather than treating the prior-result packet as the current proposal.

Both proposed writes are supported and address owned parameter subjects with no baseline facts. The gobj write accurately describes local extraction, linked-facing read, mutation and forwarding. The msid write accurately distinguishes unchanged forwarding and observed caller choices from local validation.

Read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered forms, enumerated all 21 subjects and 54 baseline facts, and read all 16 exact outgoing link records. Canonical foreign definitions and consumers confirm the capture-to-entry chain, Confusion registration, callback-table assignments, position callback arithmetic, accessory dispatch gates, common-field assignment and animation-helper call sequence.

The eight callback bodies are genuinely empty. Their lack of local collision, physics or input work does not prove global terrain immunity, platform pull-through, suppression of all engine physics or absence of every player-controlled exit.
The top-level ledger correctly defers the airborne-physics fact whose rationale asserts an unverified compiled four-byte match. Section layout and literal-pool claims likewise remain unresolved.

Independent dispositions below additionally defer the entry-purpose record's linked-animation-source rationale and the grounded IASA record's potentially state-wide exit claim. These are explicit uncertainty dispositions, not findings requiring replacement writes; they do not invalidate either proposed parameter write.

functionality.md contains one malformed revision in its entry-sequence paragraph, immediately followed by the explicitly identified correctly pinned citation for the same claim. This redundant typo is non-blocking: the claim and proposal evidence independently use the valid canonical revision.

Acceptance is limited to the immutable two-write proposal and the supported or explicitly deferred claims in this review. It does not establish compiled register allocation, section contents, complete linked-object lifetime or deferred gameplay mechanics.
